description: This file implements SSH sandbox management functions such as creating, configuring, and running SSH commands within a sandbox environment. It includes utilities for handling SSH sessions, preparing configuration files, executing remote commands, and uploading directories via SSH.

methods.name: function normalizeInlineSshMaterial(contents: string, filename: string): string { normalizeInlineSshMaterial
methods.description: Normalizes SSH key or certificate material by removing BOM, normalizing newlines, and expanding escaped newlines.

methods.description: Builds a human-readable error message based on SSH stderr output and exit code.

methods.name: export function shellEscape(value: string): string { shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a shell command string by escaping and concatenating command arguments.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Builds a shell command with optional workdir and environment variables for remote execution.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Generates argument list for invoking SSH with the sandbox session and remote command.
